Item 7.01.  Regulation FD Disclosure.
-------------------------------------

On 27 September 2005, Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. issued a press release
announcing an adjustment to its earnings guidance from the impact of hurricanes
Katrina and Rita as well as announcing its fourth quarter earnings
teleconference. A copy of the Press Release dated 27 September 2005 is attached
as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K. The Press Release is being furnished; it is
not deemed to be filed.

Item 9.01. Financial Statements and Exhibits.
---------------------------------------------
